subject: Hosted API upgrade path and soft-throttle holdback
messages:
From: Leo Chen <leo.chen@pulsestore.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Park <sarah.park@pulsestore.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API commit uplift for Q4 campaigns

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. After reviewing our Q4 roadmap we expect a 2.6x increase in generative API calls (see attached forecast). We want to lock a higher monthly commit for hosted API to avoid throttling during peak campaigns.

Key asks:
- Increase monthly committed tokens from current 50M to 140M for Oct–Dec.
- Maintain existing per-token rate bands (we can accept a slightly higher overage rate if needed).
- A short soft-throttle holdback: allow predictable soft-throttle to apply only after 15% over commit rather than immediate hard cutoffs.

Can you outline the path for pricing, provisioning lead time, and any SLA implications? We have procurement involved and would like an early heads-up on contract language.

Attached: PulseStore_Monthly_Forecast_Q4.xlsx

Cheers,
Leo
Head of Platform
PulseStore

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Leo Chen <leo.chen@pulsestore.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Sarah Park <sarah.park@pulsestore.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit uplift for Q4 campaigns

Hi Leo —

Really appreciate the forecast and the clarity on run-rate. We can support a temporary uplift to 140M/month for Oct–Dec; below is a high-level path and items we need to lock down: 

1) Pricing & rate bands
- Option A (recommended): 140M committed tokens at a blended committed rate with a 20% discount on standard hosted overage for the quarter, then revert to your standard banding in Jan.
- Option B: step-up commits (100M for Oct, 140M Nov–Dec) if you want a ramp to reduce up-front spend.

2) Soft-throttle holdback
- We can configure the soft-throttle threshold to trigger after 15% over commit during the quarter; soft-throttle will return 429s with a Retry-After backoff and an informative header so your infra can gracefully degrade.
- Hard throttle and quota enforcement remain in effect for sustained sustained overages >30% for more than 72 hours unless we activate burst credits.

3) Provisioning lead time
- We need a 14–21 day provisioning window to ensure the dedicated burst capacity and routing rules are in place.

4) Contract/Procurement
- I'll loop in Legal for the term amendment and a short term sheet. Karthik will follow up on commercial confirmation.

I attached a short provisioning summary (provisioning-delta-summary.pdf) that outlines latency expectations and ops runbook. If you can confirm preferred option (A or B) today, we can start the provisioning queue.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachment: provisioning-delta-summary.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Leo Chen <leo.chen@pulsestore.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Park <sarah.park@pulsestore.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit uplift for Q4 campaigns

Leo —

Thanks Marissa. Quick commercial note from my side: we can do Option A (140M committed with 20% overage discount) for the Oct–Dec window with the following constraints:

- Minimum 3-month commitment for the uplift (Oct–Dec).
- One-time provisioning fee of $12,500 to reserve burst capacity and priority routing.
- We can include a one-off service credit (equivalent to 10% of the provisioning fee) if you sign the amendment by Aug 24.

I'll prepare a term-sheet for procurement and route to Legal. Any specific PO / SOW cadence your procurement team needs?

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Account Director, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

From: Leo Chen <leo.chen@pulsestore.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: PulseStore Procurement <procurement@pulsestore.com>, Sarah Park <sarah.park@pulsestore.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit uplift for Q4 campaigns

Thanks Karthik — this looks workable. Procurement notes:
- PO timeline: we can issue a PO by Aug 28 if we have draft language for the amendment (we need the provisioning fee called out and the soft-throttle behavior defined).
- Please include an explicit clause: "soft-throttle threshold will be 15% above committed tokens for duration of the uplift window" and observable metrics for throttles in the Console.

We'll take the Option A + early-sign credit. Please route the term sheet and the amended Redwood_Term_Sheet_v3.docx to procurement and cc me.

-Leo
